newsitem.title: USA: Burlington Air Express acquires Chile partner OISS.
newsitem.headline: Burlington Air Express acquires Chile partner OISS.

text.p: Burlington Air Express, part of Pittson Co, said its Chilean subsidiary has acquired the assets of long-time network partner OISSA.

Burlington Air Express Chile Ltda. has taken over all staff and equipment of the company which served as its export agent, the U.S. global express company/freight forwarder said. Terms were not disclosed.
Burlington described OISSAA as the leading export forwarder in Chile, and the leading IATA export agent in Chile. OISSA had served as Burlington Chile's network partner for the last 10 years.
